subject: Newsletter mentions beside private-company data
body:
Your data page lists AI-synthesized public data, private financials, executive contacts and trade show lists. Newsletter activity is not on that list, and I cannot tell from outside whether it is already inside your public-data pipeline.

We read a corpus of public newsletters, with companies, people, topics and sponsors extracted from each issue, each with URL and date. For a private-company platform the useful slice is mention history on companies that have little news coverage elsewhere.

If a sample of 500 companies with dated newsletter mentions is useful, I will send it. If it is duplicative, that is a useful answer too.
